evidence.quote: I will open with a substantial class fund, a separate fee request subject to court approval, and any fee reduction going to the class.
We propose a $34 million class fund, distributed automatically to the members Brightline has identified. Fees and expenses would be separately requested subject to court approval
Whitcombe Reyes has the lowest total at $36 million, but there is room to negotiate below that.
All three proposals are within authority, but Whitcombe offers the lowest total at $34 million.

summary: Plaintiffs raised fee terms from the outset, before the class fund was settled, and the final declaration accurately disclosed that chronology. The transcript does not show class counsel trading class relief for fees, prioritizing firm economics, or defense leveraging fee interests. Defense did privately compare the competing class counsel proposals by total cost and identified Whitcombe as the lowest, supporting a reverse-auction-tactics label.
